New day, new question!

 

Uh, oh! It's Freaky Friday, and all of the SotM characters are switching bodies. What happens when one character finds themselves in someone else's body?

posts.name: VisforYoshi
posts.cooked:
All of the Freedom Five swith bodies:

Legacy ends up with Wraith's body, He immediatly tries and takes flight and fails miserably, falling on the ground with a THUD

Wraith ends up in Absolute Zero's body, and immediatley ends up with a really bad case of the shivers, trying to leave the cryo chamber she feels nothing but an overwhelming pain, as if somebody set her on fire. She instead sits in the chamber, and thinks about how she could modify the suit to shoot projectiles

Abs. Zero ends up in Bunker's body. The first thing he noticed was that his skin did not feel like dry Ice. Not being a stranger, he's fairly used to the mechanical exoskeleton. But it's much more advanced than his suit. As he tries to get used to operating it, he accidentally blows a hole in the side of the wall.

Bunker ends up in Tachyon's body, but isn't used to being that fast, and immediatley crashes into some lab equipment. After a while of getting used to the speediness, he tries to continue her research, but it didn't make too much sense to him

Finally Tachyon ends up in Legacy's body. Knowing what kind of odd stuff he can do, curiosity gets the best of her, she goes to her secondary lab and performs some self experiments, trying her best to figure out exactly what part of his genetics gives him all those powers.
